headlines.title: 并购重组市场活跃度稳步提升，交易逻辑转向产业价值整合
headlines.summary: A股并购重组市场活跃度稳步提升。权威数据显示，今年前7个月，A股市场披露资产重组方案1425单，其中重大资产重组78单。在业内人士看来，此轮并购重组市场回暖，在交易数量提升的同时，交易逻辑逐步转向产业价值整合，交易质量导向显著增强，推动资本市场与产业升级形成正向循环。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: M&A market activity steadily rises, deal logic shifts to industrial value integration
headlines.summary_en: A-share M&A market activity is steadily rising. Official data shows that in the first seven months of this year, 1,425 asset restructuring proposals were disclosed on the A-share market, including 78 major asset restructurings. Industry insiders say the M&A market recovery is driven not only by higher deal volume but also by a shift toward industrial value integration, with a stronger quality-oriented approach, fostering a positive cycle between capital markets and industrial upgrading. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: China’s factory activity improves in August, but stays in contraction
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) was 49.8 in August, up from 49.2 in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday. The reading was largely in line with the 49.85 projection from economists polled by the...
headlines.title_zh: 中国8月工厂活动改善，但仍处于收缩区间
headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月工厂活动有所改善，但连续第二个月处于收缩区间，因订单回升未能完全抵消整体内需疲软和极端天气干扰的影响。数据显示，8月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.8，高于7月的49.2。

headlines.title: 券商分仓佣金上半年近乎翻倍，卖方研究加速向价值创造转型
headlines.summary: 券商分仓佣金上半年成绩单出炉，行业迎来久违的高增长。Choice数据显示，上半年券商获得公募基金分仓佣金收入合计约87.24亿元，相较2025年同期的44.74亿元接近翻倍。在收入排名前50的券商中，49家实现同比正增长，22家收入实现翻倍。业内人士认为，规模快速扩张背后，交易活跃度抬升与基金产品扩容构成核心驱动力。在费率改革持续推进的大背景下，卖方研究业务模式正从“通道收费”转向“价值创造”，各家券商也在“内外兼修”中形成自己的打法。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Broker commission income nearly doubles in H1, sell-side research accelerates shift to value creation
headlines.summary_en: Brokerage commission sharing for H1 results are out, with the industry seeing long-awaited high growth. Choice data shows that in H1, brokerages earned roughly 8.724 billion yuan in public fund commission-sharing income, nearly doubling from 4.474 billion yuan in the same period of 2025. Among the top 50 brokers by revenue, 49 posted year-on-year growth and 22 saw revenue double. Industry insiders say the rapid expansion is driven by higher trading activity and fund product growth. Amid ongoing fee reform, sell-side research models are shifting from 'channel fees' to 'value creation,' with brokers developing their own strategies through internal and external efforts. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 派发2500多亿元“红包”，A股上市银行中期分红阵营扩大
headlines.summary: 随着2026年上市银行半年报季收官，“中期分红”成为最受市场关注的关键词。截至8月底，各类型银行相继披露中期分红计划，合计拟派发现金红利超过2500亿元，参与中期分红的A股银行数量已从去年的24家扩大至31家。从结构特征看，国有大行分红总量最大；股份制银行平均分红比例相对较高，分红力度较为突出；城商行整体分红比例略低，呈现一定的梯度差异。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: A-share listed banks expand interim dividend camp, distributing over 250 billion yuan in 'red envelopes'
headlines.summary_en: As the 2026 interim reporting season for listed banks wraps up, 'interim dividends' have become the most market-watched keyword. As of end-August, banks of all types disclosed interim dividend plans, with total proposed cash dividends exceeding 250 billion yuan. The number of A-share banks participating in interim dividends has expanded from 24 last year to 31. Structurally, state-owned big banks have the largest total payouts; joint-stock banks show relatively higher average payout ratios with substantial dividend strength; city commercial banks have slightly lower overall payout ratios, displaying a gradient difference. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary: 随着2026年基金中期报告披露完毕，ETF持有人结构浮出水面。从总体来看，过去半年来，个人投资者持有ETF的比例大幅提升。数据显示，截至6月底，个人投资者持有ETF份额从2025年底的1.08万亿份增至1.25万亿份，个人投资者的持有比例从33.07%增至43.01%。从股票型ETF持有人结构变化来看，截至6月底，个人投资者持有股票型ETF份额从2025年底的7143.51亿份增至8106.93亿份，个人投资者持有比例从32.59%增至43.61%。（上证报）

headlines.summary_zh: 随着2026年基金中期报告披露完毕，ETF持有人结构浮出水面。从总体来看，过去半年来，个人投资者持有ETF的比例大幅提升。数据显示，截至6月底，个人投资者持有ETF份额从2025年底的1.08万亿份增至1.25万亿份，个人投资者的持有比例从33.07%增至43.01%。从股票型ETF持有人结构变化来看，截至6月底，个人投资者持有股票型ETF份额从2025年底的7143.51亿份增至8106.93亿份，个人投资者持有比例从32.59%增至43.61%。（上证报）
headlines.title_en: Individual ETF holdings ratio jumps to 43% in half a year
headlines.summary_en: With 2026 fund interim reports fully disclosed, ETF holder structures have emerged. Overall, retail investors' share of ETF holdings rose significantly over the past six months. Data shows that as of end-June, retail investors' ETF holdings increased from 1.08 trillion units at end-2025 to 1.25 trillion units, with their share rising from 33.07% to 43.01%. For stock ETFs, retail holdings grew from 714.351 billion units at end-2025 to 810.693 billion units by end-June, with their proportion rising from 32.59% to 43.61%. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary_en: Chinese and foreign institutions: Despite Warsh's hawkish tone, Fed September rate hike not a done deal. On the evening of August 28 Beijing time, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a speech at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium, his first appearance at the major event since taking office. At the key juncture of his first 100 days, what signals did Warsh's speech convey? Chinese and foreign institutions engaged in lively discussion.
